label: dCTPdeaminase system
definition: A phage defense system in which a dCTPdeaminase locus depletes dCTP by converting it into deoxy-uracil nucleotides during phage infection, starving the phage of an essential DNA building block and halting phage replication.
observations: dCTPdeaminase branch under phage defense system; distinct from generic dCTP deaminase enzymes, dcd or dCMP deaminase genes, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, source database rows naming the profile, deoxy-uracil nucleotide products, nucleotide-depletion processes, the dGTPase system, the Gabija nucleotide-depletion output, and other phage defense systems.
